facts.anchor: Shelby stayed an extra night in Kelowna. She’d made it there safely on Friday night but wanted to hang out with her friend until Sunday.
facts.fact: Shelby 在 Kelowna 多留一晚（周五夜已安全抵达、与朋友待到周日）。

facts.anchor: What could I say? She was an adult. I swallowed my disappointment and texted her to let me know when she was on the road again, adding, Drive safe.
facts.fact: 周日清早 Roddie 打游戏、母亲与老邻居外出吃饭——Meg 只想洗床单、把性玩具藏起来（Shelby 要跟她同睡）。

facts.anchor: Her recovery was coming along well. She’d started physiotherapy, but she was working so hard to get back to full strength, she didn’t have much pep left after her exercises.

facts.anchor: “Gail doesn’t want any?” I asked, taking the bag of sample toys I’d left a couple of weeks ago.
facts.fact: 她走出 Georgia 家时想到 Shelby 正在靠近渡轮、母亲外出、Roddie 忙——两小时空档成形。

facts.anchor: “She says her husband gives her all she needs.” She shrugged. “I kept the one I opened and put a list in there of the ones I think you should stock. Try some yourself. See what you think.”
